title: Man accused of raping three women in New York’s Central Park is arrested in Miami | CNN
text:
Source: CNN

A man accused of raping three women in New York’s Central Park over the span of five years has been arrested in Florida, police announced Tuesday.

Dereck Rivera-Deleon, 30, was taken into custody with the support of the US Marshals while working at a Burger King in Miami Beach, the New York Police Departmentsaid in a post on X.

He is accused of raping a woman in Central Park on October 24, 2026, and will also be charged with two rapes that occurred in the popular park in 2023 and 2021, police said.

DNA evidence and positive identification from victims connected Rivera-Deleon to the crimes, Miami Beach Police said in a news release obtained by CNN affiliate WPLG. Detectives determined he had recently arrived in South Florida, police said.

Rivera-Deleon is being held in Miami-Dade County and is scheduled for an extradition hearing on Wednesday, officials there said. CNN is attempting to determine whether he has an attorney.

NYPD Crime Stoppers previously asked for help identifying the man following last month’s attack, saying he displayed a knife and sexually assaulted a 39-year-old woman before fleeing on foot. Rivera-Deleon allegedly forced the victim into a wooded area before assaulting her, Miami Beach police said.

This was the fifth reported rape in Central Park this year, according to the NYPD. Crime has been trending down overall in the city, but reported rapes increased 3.7% year to date,according tothe NYPD.

The scenic park, popular among New Yorkers and tourists alike, was also the site of a homicide earlier this year: A 63-year-old woman was found dead with trauma to her head on the morning of September 27. A 36-year-old man was arrested and charged with murder the following day, police said.

CNN has reached out to the Manhattan district attorney’s office and the US Marshals for comment.

CNN’s Gloria Pazmino and Cara Lynn Clarkson contributed to this report.
